purpose: Teach: ありふれ/眠ら/怯え/おろそか/膨れ/太り/はいり/たたい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の日記、ありふれた話ばっかだな
lines.en: Your diary's just full of boring stuff, Riku.
lines.style: Quick, teasing jab delivered with a smirk. Leaning in. The rhythm of someone used to getting away with ribbing. Light but pointed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、徹夜で眠らずゲームしてたな、桜
lines.en: You stayed up all night gaming instead of sleeping, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat parry — not defensive, just turning it back. Slight smile in the voice. The ease of someone who knows they're caught and doesn't care. Rhythm mirrors hers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お化け屋敷で怯えてたな
lines.en: You were literally shaking in that haunted house, Riku.
lines.style: Sharper this time — pressing the advantage. Quick delivery, almost sing-song with satisfaction. The warmth underneath doesn't hide the glee.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強おろそかにすんなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't slack off on schoolwork, Sakura.
lines.style: Shift into quiet firmness — the mask slips for a moment. Even pacing, no playfulness. Real concern disguised as a lecture. Back to her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お腹膨れてる、食べ過ぎだろ
lines.en: You've definitely gotten soft around the middle, Riku. Eating too much.
lines.style: Back to teasing but with a sharper edge — personal now. Quick, elbowing tone. The kind of jab that lands because they know each other. Slight pause before his name.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みで太り始めたな、桜
lines.en: You started putting on weight over summer break, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Mirror-image counter — same accusation, same warmth underneath. Slightly slower, almost lazy in delivery. The confidence of someone who's won this round already.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、教室にはいり前に手洗いしろよ
lines.en: Wash your hands before you come into class, Riku.
lines.style: Sudden shift to genuine instruction — brief, matter-of-fact. The teacher's voice underneath. No teasing now. Quick and direct, like she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ボールをたたいてばっかいたな、桜
lines.en: You were just out there smacking that ball around the whole time, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Final volley — lighter again, but tired. Settling tone at the close. The warmth of someone who's watched him do this a hundred times. Small exhale before her name.
